title: Caribbean Rice and Beans
subtitle: Rice cooked in coconut milk with kidney beans and thyme
excerpt: Long-grain rice cooked in coconut milk with kidney beans, spring onion, thyme and allspice. The coconut milk gives the rice a rich, slightly sweet flavour. This is the backbone of Caribbean cooking.
sourceNotes: Rice and peas or rice and beans is eaten across the Caribbean. This version reflects the Jamaican and Trinidadian style using coconut milk.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze in portions once fully cooled. Reheat from frozen in the microwave with a tablespoon of water to loosen.
recipe.batchNotes: Doubles well. Use a larger saucepan and keep the coconut milk to water ratio the same.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Cook up to a day ahead and reheat gently with a splash of water to loosen the grains.

content.text: Caribbean rice and beans is a side dish that can carry a whole meal on its own. The key is sealing the pot at the end and letting the rice steam undisturbed. Do not lift the lid during that final rest.

items.prepNote: rinsed until the water runs clear

content.text: Warm the oil in a medium saucepan over a medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, water, spring onions, thyme, allspice, scotch bonnet and salt. Stir and bring to a simmer.
Add the kidney beans and stir once. Taste the liquid and adjust the salt.
Add the rinsed rice and stir gently to distribute evenly. Bring back to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to very low. Cover tightly with a lid and cook for 18 minutes.
Remove from the heat. Leave covered for 10 minutes to finish steaming.
Remove the spring onions, thyme stalks and scotch bonnet. Fluff the rice gently with a fork and serve.

items.symptom: The rice is stodgy and clumped together.
items.cause: The rice was not rinsed, or too much liquid was used.
items.fix: Always rinse rice until the water runs clear. Measure the coconut milk and water carefully.

items.symptom: The rice has scorched on the bottom.
items.cause: The heat was too high or the lid was not tight.
items.fix: Use the lowest hob setting. Place a folded tea towel under the lid to trap steam more effectively.

items.symptom: The rice is undercooked after 18 minutes.
items.cause: The lid was lifted during cooking and steam was lost.
items.fix: Add 2 tablespoons of hot water around the edge, replace the lid and steam for 5 more minutes.
